summary: Ad-hoc live audit probe + structured SIEM schema & signed archive for pending subpoena
description:
Issue summary:
Acme Legal has issued a preservation request and technical subpoena requiring: (1) a live SIEM-friendly forwarder sample for ingestion (TCP/TLS + JSON lines), (2) a 7-day immutable S3 archive of audit events with per-file SHA256 manifests and KMS-signed metadata, and (3) an event lineage map that ties event_id -> request_id -> tenant_id with redaction proof for PII fields. Customer needs this delivered as an evidence bundle for counsel by 2026-03-13.

Impact:
Customer cannot produce civil subpoena evidence until we provide both live-forwarder samples and verifiable archived snapshots. This is blocking their legal team.

Requested deliverables:
- Live Splunk/Generic TCP-TLS JSON-lines sample with field whitelist mapping (no PII), sample data, and recommended ingestion props.
- 7-day immutable S3 archive export (UTC) with a manifest file listing file checksums (sha256) and object last-modified; manifest must be KMS-signed and notarized with a timestamp.
- Event lineage export (CSV) mapping audit.event_id -> trace.request_id -> tenant_id with a proof of redaction (hashes) for any removed fields.
- A short runbook for how the customer can verify hashes + manifest and a signed statement of custody.

Environment / context:
- Tenant: acme-prod-01 (enterprise)
- Region: us-east-1
- Preferred delivery: S3 presigned URLs for archive download + a dedicated Splunk TLS endpoint sample (customer will stand up collector).

Steps customer took:
1) Attempted to enable "Live SIEM Forwarder" in Console -> Audit -> Forwarding to Splunk.
2) Received error in Console: "Forwarder enable failed: 403 Forbidden - S3 ACL disallows PutObject".
3) Opened support chat and received presigned S3 link attempt from UI; download failed with AccessDenied.

Relevant logs (redacted):
- forwarder-engine: err=403 tenant=acme-prod-01 operation=enable-forwarder target=s3://redwood-archives/acme-prod-01/2026-03-09/ reason="AccessDenied: PutObject"
- audit-exporter: warn=rate_limit tenant=acme-prod-01 payloads_dropped=12 window_ms=60000
- signing-service: info=sign-request kms_key=projects/rw/keys/evidence-key status=OK timestamp=2026-03-09T17:12:04Z

Customer expectation:
They asked for a short handoff call with SRE + Support and delivery of the evidence bundle (manifest + signed metadata + sample SIEM payloads) within 48 hours.

Attachments provided by customer:
- screenshot_enable_error.png (console error)
- subpoena_notice.pdf (redacted)
comments: 2026-03-10 09:14 - Maya Chen (Reporter): Opening ticket on behalf of Acme Legal. Customer is urgent and needs evidence pack for subpoena. Requested ETA 2026-03-13.
2026-03-10 09:45 - Support (Luca Moretti): Acknowledged. First steps: collecting access logs and confirming S3 ACLs. Assigning to SRE for ACL review.
2026-03-10 11:02 - SRE (Priya Nair): Observed S3 PutObject denied; bucket policy requires AWS account canonical ID which was not included in UI presigned flow. Raised INT-421 to fix onboarding flow.
2026-03-11 08:30 - Customer (Acme SOC): Can you provide a sample JSON-lines payload and the field mapping now so our collector team can test ingestion before archive is ready?
2026-03-12 14:21 - Support (Luca Moretti): Provided sample payload and Splunk props via secure upload. Scheduled a 30 minute handoff call for 2026-03-12 16:00 UTC with SRE and legal ops.
2026-03-13 10:10 - Legal Ops (Acme): Confirmed receipt of sample; requesting manifest be KMS-signed using evidence-key_2026. Need verification instructions.
investigation_notes: Checked Console job run: forwarder-enable job failed at step PutObject to archive bucket. Error trace matches missing PutObject permission for the service role 'redwood-audit-writer'.

Bucket policy requires explicit aws:PrincipalAccount; UI presigned flow omitted account context when doing cross-account presigns. Workaround: generate temporary STS session for service role and use server-side upload to archive bucket.

Rate limiting observed on audit-exporter during 2026-03-09 17:00-17:15 UTC — 12 payloads dropped; likely caused by a short burst when customer replayed events. Need to backfill dropped window as part of evidence pack.
Signing service returned OK earlier; KMS key evidence-key_2026 exists and is in keyring; will need to produce signed manifest using signing-service v2.1 (PR referenced).
resolution_notes:
Planned resolution and owner actions:
1) SRE (Priya) to apply temporary ACL patch to allow server-side PutObject from 'redwood-audit-writer' and verify archive creation by 2026-03-11 02:00 UTC (done).
2) Support to run an on-demand backfill job to capture the 12 dropped payloads and include them in the archive (scheduled 2026-03-11 06:00 UTC; job id: backfill-77333-1).
3) Produce S3 archive with per-file sha256 manifest and KMS-signed manifest using evidence-key_2026; upload manifests to secure delivery bucket and provide presigned download to customer.
4) Provide sample Splunk TCP/TLS JSON-lines payloads and ingestion props (delivered 2026-03-12).
5) Deliver a verification checklist + short runbook for customer to validate hashes and KMS signature and provide chain-of-custody statement.
6) Follow-up: engineering will add an onboarding validation to ensure UI presign includes account context (tracked in INT-421, PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5872).

Status: partial delivery complete (samples uploaded, ACL patch applied). Archive manifest generation in progress; expected final bundle delivery 2026-03-14.
notes_to_legal: Signed manifest will include: list of archive objects (UTC), per-object sha256, KMS signature fingerprint, and timestamp (RFC3339). Customer counsel should verify signature against evidence-key_2026 public key available in Confluence page. For chain-of-custody, we will include an exported support thread and console job execution logs showing job start/stop and signer identity.
next_steps: Complete manifest KMS signing and deliver presigned archive URLs to Acme Legal by 2026-03-14
SRE to close INT-421 after PR merges and onboarding validation added
Schedule post-delivery call to walk counsel through verification steps
